items.title: Release v1.0.0-preview.2
items.en_oneliner: Qwen Code v1.0.0-preview.2 adds Qwen4-Max to the subscription catalog (1M context, image and video input), shows a reset countdown when credits run out, and adds an /upgrade command that opens the plans page.
Claude Code 2.1.332 brings in beta support for skills served by MCP servers, plus a PreSkillShellCommand hook that can refuse inline scripts before a skill or command runs.

items.title: The Agent Lake
items.en_oneliner: LangSmith's Agent Lake gathers every trace agents produce, surfaces the high-signal ones, and converts them into fixes and fine-tuning data.

items.en_title: How We Achieved ISO 42001 with LangSmith
items.en_oneliner: LangSmith helped LangChain secure ISO/IEC 42001 certification for its AI management system, and the team explains the process behind it.

items.title: v1.107.11 (2026-11-24)

items.title: v2.74.0 (2026-11-24)
items.en_oneliner: Pydantic AI 2.74.0 adds a computer-use tool contract to the core, letting agents call ComputerTool directly to operate a computer.
